short: The US lab behind the GPT models and ChatGPT, closely partnered with Microsoft.
definition: OpenAI is a US AI research and deployment company founded in 2015 that builds the GPT family of large language models, the o-series reasoning models, and image and video systems, and runs the ChatGPT product and a developer API (a way for other software to call its models). It completed a restructuring in October 2025 that split it into a nonprofit, the OpenAI Foundation, which controls a for-profit public benefit corporation, OpenAI Group PBC; Microsoft holds roughly a quarter of that for-profit entity as part of their deep partnership.
